Are You Deficient in Vitamin D? 5 Signs to Watch For | Dr. Hansaji
Vitamin D plays an important role in calcium absorption, bone health and muscle function. Although it is called a vitamin, it also acts like a hormone in the body. Low levels can sometimes be associated with muscle weakness, aches and bone pain, although these symptoms can have many other causes.
